purpose: Authoritative semantics for what inventory visibility was actually obtained for each employer check

CHECKED_ZERO.meaning: Current official inventory was successfully verified and contained zero relevant/live jobs for the monitored Madrid inventory scope.
requires: official inventory scope was readable enough to establish a real zero
no unresolved subsystem or configured partial-source gap remains
forbidden_when: source/configured health is PARTIAL/WEAK/BLOCKED and the limitation prevents complete inventory verification
JS shell, placeholder, 404/406, stale index or dynamic empty state prevents proving zero

CHECKED_WITH_INVENTORY.meaning: Current official inventory was successfully verified and one or more live jobs were visible in the monitored Madrid inventory scope, regardless of whether any qualify for alerting.
requires: at least one live official inventory item or live official role was verified

PARTIAL_COVERAGE.meaning: Some current official coverage was obtained but completeness could not be established for the full configured employer scope.
typical_cases: configured PARTIAL/WEAK/BLOCKED source behaved within its documented limitation
one subsystem succeeded while another official subsystem remained unavailable
root/search failed but some official role pages were recoverable without proving full inventory
official dynamic or local-vs-global coverage remains structurally incomplete
requires: coverage_status is PARTIAL_OR_WEAK_CHECKED or FAILED_RECORDED with some verified official visibility
note identifies the unresolved completeness limitation

UNAVAILABLE.meaning: No reliable current official inventory visibility could be established after the configured primary and recovery path for this run.
requires: primary_result is FAILED or NOT_APPLICABLE where policy permits
prior snapshot is preserved and must not be overwritten with zero

field_rules.inventory_visibility: Must be exactly one of CHECKED_ZERO, CHECKED_WITH_INVENTORY, PARTIAL_COVERAGE, UNAVAILABLE.
field_rules.inventory_item_count_observed: Integer >=0 only when a reliable official count/set was directly observed. Use null when count cannot be established. CHECKED_ZERO requires 0. CHECKED_WITH_INVENTORY requires >=1. PARTIAL_COVERAGE may be null or a lower-bound observed count. UNAVAILABLE must be null.
field_rules.inventory_scope_note: Short statement of what inventory scope was actually visible, especially for PARTIAL_COVERAGE/UNAVAILABLE. It is diagnostic metadata, not routing authority.

consistency_rules: CHECKED_ZERO may never be inferred from request failure, source failure, empty JS shell, placeholder, stale index, 404, 406, LinkedIn-only discovery or missing crawlable inventory.
CHECKED_WITH_INVENTORY says inventory existed, not that any role qualified for the user's target filter.
PARTIAL_COVERAGE must not be converted to CHECKED_ZERO just because zero qualifying target roles were found among the visible subset.
UNAVAILABLE must preserve the previous inventory snapshot and never close/disappear requisitions solely because this run could not see them.

If an employer has multiple official subsystems, CHECKED_ZERO is allowed only when all configured inventory-bearing subsystems needed for completeness were successfully checked or the routing policy explicitly defines the checked subset as authoritative.
A HEALTHY source whose primary fails but official fallback fully verifies inventory may be CHECKED_ZERO or CHECKED_WITH_INVENTORY with coverage_status RECOVERED_VIA_OFFICIAL_FALLBACK.

A successful official role-page recovery that proves only individual roles but not the full inventory is PARTIAL_COVERAGE, not CHECKED_WITH_INVENTORY for the whole employer unless routing policy says role-page discovery is inventory-complete.
safety_net_priority: PARTIAL_COVERAGE with new deterioration or missing configured subsystem
CHECKED_ZERO/CHECKED_WITH_INVENTORY require no coverage retry unless other heartbeat validation fails
